construction: Take X=(-3/4,-1/4,1/4,3/4) and Z=(-1,-3/4,1,1) in S=(X,3X^2-1+Z). The score table is exactly centered. Cuts at +/-1/3 give labels (0,1,1,2); moving row 2 from the middle to the right cell gives the displayed improvement.
